mentions.name: Minimalist single-line journal app
mentions.description: A minimalist journal app for very quick single-line jots, supporting idea dumping, project management, quick calculations, unit conversion, and task management, with unlimited undo/redo and tagging. Data is stored in a human-friendly text file designed so *nix tool users can navigate it with text processing tools. Next step is adding Python scripting support. It is a native application (no web UI) built with Rust and iced.rs with minimal dependencies, no AI, and a focus on instant loading, extreme simplicity, and a minimal, discoverable interface.
mentions.audience: Users who want the simplicity of a (non-sloppy) notepad with some bells and whistles, without worrying about managing metadata manually; includes *nix tool users.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a minimalist journal app that is for really quick single line jots. Can be used for idea dumping, project management, quick calculations, unit conversion, task management etc. Have unlimited undo/redo support, assign tags etc.
